part.text:
Fixed. The CRLF issue was in `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` (packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownUtils.ts:5990): its regexes only matched `\n` boundaries, so an `mdx-code-block` fenced with CRLF line endings was never unwrapped, causing the MDX compilation error for `TabItem`.

Change: updated `regexp3`/`regexp4` to accept `\r?\n` at each boundary (matching upstream fix facebook/docusaurus#9897).

Validation:
- `unwrapMdxCodeBlocks` tests (incl. the CRLF case) pass
- `packages/docusaurus-utils`: 260 passed; the one failure (`globUtils`) is pre-existing and unrelated (verified via `git stash`)
- `packages/docusaurus-mdx-loader`: 67 passed
